refnamediv.refpurpose: Convert a string from one character encoding to another

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.parameters;
from_encoding
The current encoding used to interpret string.
to_encoding
The desired encoding of the result.
Appending //TRANSLIT to to_encoding requests transliteration: characters that cannot be represented in the target encoding may be approximated by one or more similar characters. Appending //IGNORE requests that characters which cannot be represented in the target encoding be discarded. Some implementations also support //NON_IDENTICAL_DISCARD to discard valid input characters that have no identical representation in the target encoding.
Whether these suffixes are supported and how they behave depend on the system's iconv implementation (see ICONV_IMPL). Without a supported suffix, unrepresentable characters may cause the conversion to fail with an E_NOTICE and return &false;, or may be handled differently by the implementation.
string
The &string; to be converted.

&reftitle.notes;
The supported source and target encodings and their interpretation depend on the installed iconv implementation. If the implementation rejects the requested encoding or conversion, &false; is returned.
